```python
script = '''\
import fitz
import pytesseract
from pdf2image import convert_from_path
import os

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"

# --- Part 1: Extract embedded text from all pages ---
print("=" * 60)
print("PART 1: EXTRACTED TEXT FROM handbook.pdf")
print("=" * 60)
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
total_pages = len(doc)
print(f"Total pages: {total_pages}\\n")

all_text = []
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    all_text.append(text)
    print(f"--- Page {i+1} ---")
    print(text if text.strip() else "(no embedded text)")
    print()
doc.close()

# --- Part 2: OCR on the first page image ---
print("=" * 60)
print("PART 2: OCR RESULT FOR FIRST PAGE IMAGE")
print("=" * 60)

images = convert_from_path(pdf_path, first_page=1, last_page=1, dpi=300)
first_page_img = images[0]

# Save the first page image for reference
first_page_img.save("output/handbook_page1.png", "PNG")
print("First page image saved to output/handbook_page1.png")

ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(first_page_img)
print("\\nOCR Text from first page:")
print("-" * 40)
print(ocr_text)
print("-" * 40)
print("\\nDone.")
'''
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print("Script written.")

await make_directory("./output")
print("output dir ready")

result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py 2>&1")
print(result)
```
